sunday 18th october the mission sunday collection will be taken up as a second collection at all masses this weekend. thank you for your support. prayer of pope leoxiv for the 100th world mission sunday 2026 holy father, make us one in christ, rooted in his love that unites and renews. may all members of the church be united in mission, docile to the holy spirit, courageous in bearing witness to the gospel, proclaiming and daily embodying your faithful love for all creatures. bless all missionary men and women, support them in their efforts, and watch over them in hope! mary, queen of missions, accompany our work of evangelization in every corner of the earth: make us instruments of peace, and grant that the whole world may recognize in christ the light that saves. our mission send me, lord, out into the world that begins at my front door. may my every word flow from your heart and my actions be of love and peace that everything i do or say reflects your great mercy to all.# help me witness to your truth no less in my silence than in my words and show me, lord, the way i should go. help me to see that my solemn duty to spread your gospel to everyone in the world is second only to their right to hear and respond to it. open my eyes to your presence in others and my ears to recognise your voice especially in the poor and oppressed. amen. prayer by fr joe veneroso mm irish national synodal assembly, “what does god want from the church in ireland at this time?” the working document for the irish national synodal assembly, taking place in gormanston, co meath, on 17 october, brings together the fruits of five years of prayer, listening and discernment and will guide delegates as they consider and vote on suggested actions to be presented to the bishops of ireland. while the assembly marks an important moment in the journey, the synodal pathway is now moving towards a new phase of implementation. everyone is invited to read, pray with, and reflect on the working document and the question: “what does god want from the church in ireland at this time? ” please pray for all those taking part in the assembly and for the guidance of the holy spirit, and use the link below to access the working document and find out more.
